env_vars_integration_tab.javascript_auto_note: The same tag works in every environment: the console resolves which one answers from the domain the page is served on, so promoting a build never means editing this url.
env_vars_integration_tab.javascript_direct_api_access_description: Fetch variables directly from the API
env_vars_integration_tab.integrate_button: Add the script to my hosts
env_vars_integration_tab.integrate_dialog_description: We write the <script> tag into the document of every host, so the environment variables are available as window.globalConfig before the application starts. This is an integration of its own: it does not touch the module federation config. Review what changes, then pick what to commit: the write lands on the default branch of each repository.
